title: SiteFlow vs Fieldwire: Construction Software Comparison
metaTitle: SiteFlow vs Fieldwire: Construction Software Comparison
metaDescription: SiteFlow vs Fieldwire: Fieldwire leads on drawing management, while SiteFlow leads on BOQ-linked cost control, labour reconciliation, procurement, and India-Gulf workflows.
author: SiteFlow Operations Team
body: Fieldwire centres on drawing management and field coordination. SiteFlow is built around active project cost control where the BOQ is the base layer and day-to-day site actions connect directly to budget positions. The structured comparison below is the authoritative capability breakdown.

hero.headline: SiteFlow vs Fieldwire: Construction Software Comparison
hero.subhead: Fieldwire centres on drawing management and field coordination. SiteFlow is built around active project cost control, linking material requests, labour entries, and billing approvals directly to the BOQ.

verdict.name: SiteFlow
points: Integrated financial ledger tied to every field activity
High-fidelity BOQ tracking with planned vs actual variance
Automated labour reconciliation from verified site presence

verdict.name: Fieldwire
points: Drawing management core with plan viewing and markups
Field task communication, RFIs, and punchlists
No native accounting; relies on manual reconciliation or add-ons

approaches.label: Approach
approaches.title: SiteFlow: unified financial foundation
approaches.body: SiteFlow is built on a unified relational model that links field activities to the financial ledger, so every material request, labour hour, and progress update informs the central budget in real time.
bullets: No data silos or double entry

approaches.label: Approach
approaches.title: Fieldwire: task and plan centricity
approaches.body: Fieldwire excels at drawing management and basic field communication, but its architecture is task based and requires manual reconciliation or third-party integrations to connect field progress with financial reality.

whatIs.name: SiteFlow
whatIs.body: SiteFlow is a construction ERP where the BOQ is the base layer and every site action connects to budget positions, keeping financial movement visible while the project is still running.

whatIs.name: Fieldwire
whatIs.body: Fieldwire is a field coordination tool centred on drawings, plan markups, RFIs, and task assignments tied to current plans.

faqs.q: Is SiteFlow suitable for small subcontractors?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is built for enterprise scale, but its modular design lets mid-sized contractors adopt core features like drawing management and task tracking before scaling to full ERP capabilities.

faqs.q: How hard is it to migrate from Fieldwire to SiteFlow?
faqs.a: SiteFlow offers dedicated onboarding and data import services to transition active projects, drawings, and task histories without disruption.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow handle India and Gulf compliance?
faqs.a: Yes. RA bill generation, Tally and Zoho Books integration, and BOQ-linked invoicing are native to SiteFlow, not add-ons, and INR pricing is built in.

cta.heading: Ready for an enterprise-grade construction platform?
cta.body: Connect your drawings, tasks, and field data to a live financial ledger with SiteFlow.
